health.title: Server health
health.description: Checks that Docker, the model gateway, your benchmarks and your agents are working.
health.hostedDescription: Your benchmarks, agents and workers that are online.

evidence.title: Saved results
evidence.description: Check, copy, archive and restore the saved results of your runs.
evidence.noMirror: No extra storage is set up for copies. Set storage.mirror_dir (a folder) or storage.s3 in the bench config, then restart the server.
evidence.deep: Thorough check (download and check every file)
evidence.dryRun: Archive practice run (only report, change nothing)
evidence.backup: Download a copy of your saved results
evidence.restoreNeedsExp: To restore, enter a comparison id.
evidence.restoreConfirm: Restore this comparison from storage back into the runs folder?
evidence.backupConfirm: Save a copy of the database and every comparison to storage?
evidence.hostedDescription: Check, download and restore the saved results of your runs.
evidence.hostedNoMirror: This server has no extra storage, so archive and restore are off. Checking and downloading a copy still work: the copy is a zip you can download below.
evidence.hostedMirror: The server keeps an extra copy of your saved comparisons; archive and restore use it.
evidence.hostedBackupConfirm: Make a zip of your saved comparisons (or the one named above)? You can download it below.
evidence.hostedRestoreConfirm: Restore this comparison of your organization from the server's extra copy?
evidence.backupsEmpty: No copies yet. Press "Download a copy of your saved results" to make one.

suite.title: Benchmark checks
suite.description: Check voice tasks and compare screenshots for a benchmark.
suite.image: Image path in the project, for example uploads/shot.png
suite.captureDescription: Take a screenshot of a running browser or desktop and save it in uploads/visual/.

simulator.title: Simulated-user comparison
simulator.description: Some tasks use an AI that plays the user. This shows how much scores change when you swap that AI: give the same comparison run with two different ones.
simulator.a: Comparison with the usual simulated user
